product.title: Joshua Tree National Park Sightseeing Adventure Tour

description.text: Explore Joshua Tree National Park on a small-group guided sightseeing adventure designed to cover major viewpoints efficiently. Travel with a local guide between park highlights, stop for short interpretive walks, and learn about desert geology, plants, and wildlife while enjoying broad scenic vistas. This half-day format is ideal for travelers who want a structured, informative experience without self-driving in the park.

itineraryItems.description: Meet your guide in Joshua Tree and start with a short orientation before entering the park corridor.

pointOfInterestLocation.fullName: Joshua Tree National Park Scenic Stops

itineraryItems.description: Drive between signature rock formations and Joshua tree groves, with multiple photo and interpretation stops selected for current conditions.
Pause at an elevated overlook to take in expansive desert basin views and late-day light across the landscape.
Return to the Joshua Tree area after a compact, guide-led sightseeing circuit through key park zones.
